capabilities: Capture memos as timestamped list items in daily or yearly notes
Browse memos in a chronological stream grouped by day
Filter and search memos by tags, status, and full-text content
Track memo activity with a 12-week heatmap calendar
Share memos as styled PNG images
extras: Manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin warning. Memos stay as timestamped list items in Markdown, so they remain compatible with Obsidian's native editing and search.
intentEvidence: A flomo-inspired memos stream plugin for Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian's daily notes store entries as plain files, with no dedicated view for capturing and browsing short memos as a chronological stream.

relations.evidence: A flomo-inspired memos stream plugin for Obsidian.

summary: Flomo-inspired memo stream that turns daily notes or yearly files into a searchable, filterable timeline of timestamped memos.
